messages:
From: Mateo Alvarez <mateo@redwood.com>

Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-06T16:12:00-05:00
Subject: Weekly MAP: POC acceptance sprintlog and open blockers

Hi Claire / Raj —

Quick weekly MAP update from the Redwood side ahead of Thursday's checkpoint. High level: we keep the POC on track for the acceptance window but one integration blocker (data masking) will push one non-critical acceptance test by ~72 hours unless we apply the mitigation below.

Current sprint snapshot:
- Eval plan: run full 3-day traffic replay (stability + accuracy) on the dedicated trial pool (v0.9). Owner: Priyom.
- Acceptance criteria (summary):
  * 99.5% uptime during 30m peak replay
  * Latency 95th <= 450ms for chat flows tested
  * No PII leakage after masking regression (see checklist)
- Blockers: Data masking script fails with anonymized CSVs coming from Acme staging; results in incomplete KV cache population (see attached MAP_v2.xlsx). Owner: Karthik.

Immediate mitigation proposal (we can enact today): Redwood to run a supervised masking pass (manual QA + script tweak) and stage a regenerated dataset for replay by Tuesday EOD. Impact: moves Acceptance Test #3 (PII masking regression) to Friday instead of Wednesday.

Action items (owners & due dates):
- Karthik Iyer: patch masking script + produce sanitized dataset (due: 2026-11-09 EOD)
- Priyom Das: schedule and run full traffic replay once sanitized dataset available (due: 2026-11-10)
- Marissa Cole: run acceptance checklist against replay and capture screenshots/logs (due: 2026-11-11)
- Mateo Alvarez: coordinate sign-off meeting and update MAP doc (due: 2026-11-12)

Attachments: MAP_v2.xlsx (spreadsheet summary of acceptance matrix & owner assignments).

Can you confirm Acme is OK with the proposed shift of the masking regression to Friday? If so we'll lock the timeline and send a brief rev to the MAP.

Thanks —
Mateo Alvarez
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
mateo@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0182

Subject: Re: Weekly MAP: POC acceptance sprintlog and open blockers

Thanks Mateo — appreciate the heads up. A couple quick items from Acme security:

- The datasets that failed masking are the same ones our security team samples for deep content inspection. We need the regenerated dataset to go through our sideband inspection before replay. Can Marissa share the sanitized CSV earlier in the day so we can start inspection?
- Also looping in Laura Bennett (security lead) internally at Acme — she may request a short pause if sideband flags anything.

From our side we'd accept moving the masking regression to Friday, but only if the sanitization + sideband review completes by Thursday noon PST. Otherwise we risk delaying the final sign-off window and pushing go-live by a week.

Raj

Subject: Internal: security sideband blocker status + proposal for contingency run (internal)

Team —

Short internal note following Acme's sideband feedback: Laura (Acme security) flagged two edge-case tokens in the sanitized output that require a small rule tweak (they sent examples). They've asked for an additional sideband pass; this would slip the current Friday sign-off into Monday unless we offer a contingency.

Recommended contingency (we can propose to Acme in the 11:00 sign-off meeting):
- Redwood to run a gated replay limited to synthetic traffic + the flagged token set in parallel (isolated trial cluster) and share results within 2 hours. This provides a quick signal without exposing production-like traffic to another sideband cycle. Owner: Priyom (execute) + Karthik (tweak rule).
- If the gated replay is green, request Acme to accept conditional sign-off with a follow-up full validation run next week.

Please confirm availability: Prio is to have the gated run ready by 11:00 sign-off meeting. Respond with "ok" and your estimated time to complete your piece.

Mateo
